# Data folder

* `raw/` — place Cricsheet T20 JSON ZIP files here (for example `t20s_json.zip`, downloaded from
  https://cricsheet.org/downloads/). ZIPs are git-ignored; do not commit them.
* `processed/` — generated by the pipeline: `matches.csv`, `deliveries.pkl`, `chase_states.pkl`,
  `quality_report.json`. Git-ignored and rebuilt automatically.

No demonstration data is bundled. The app only shows numbers computed from the ZIPs you provide.
